name: Gasthof Maierhof
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Gasthof Maierhof in Westendorf**

Nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps** in **Tirol**, **Gasthof Maierhof** invites you to experience authentic Tyrolean hospitality in a cozy mountain setting. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this charming guesthouse offers a warm retreat after a day of skiing, hiking, or exploring the stunning landscapes of the region.

Indulge in traditional Tyrolean cuisine, where every dish is prepared with local ingredients. Start your day with a hearty breakfast featuring fresh bread, homemade jams, and regional cheeses. For lunch or dinner, savor classics like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Tiroler Gröstl**, or a hearty **Kaspressknödel**—all paired with crisp **Tiroler Bier** or fine local wines.

The rooms at **Gasthof Maierhof** blend rustic charm with modern comforts, ensuring a peaceful night’s sleep. Whether you’re seeking adventure or relaxation, this idyllic retreat promises an unforgettable stay in the heart of **Tirol**.

**Come and experience the warmth of Tyrol at Gasthof Maierhof!**
